unit.why: A narrated episode: R. Yeiva of Ostroh and R. Pinchas dispute which prohibition is gravest, agree to settle it by opening a Chumash at random, and the verse with its Targum vindicates both.

stories.start_quote: פ״א התווכח הרב הקדוש רב ייב"א ז"ל
stories.end_quote: ואלו ואלו דברי אלקים חיים ודפח"ח
stories.summary_en: R. Yeiva of Ostroh holds that the gravest sin of the age is talking in the synagogue during prayer, while R. Pinchas holds it is poor Jewish girls selling food in gentile lords' houses; they open a Chumash at random to the verse 'הכזונה יעשה את אחותנו', and its Targum is read to support both views.
